reason: The brief asks for subtle scroll animations; Lenis smooth scroll is the user's standing preference for landing pages (their own lenis skill). Reveals run once, are short, and are off under reduced motion.
Aero is a fictional concept product the brief invented; the page is deployed publicly, so one plain line saying its specs, prices and quotes are not real keeps it honest.
A desk lamp is taller than it is wide: its widest (side) view already fills the full height of the product stage, so 80% of the content width would push it past the fold.
The three set options are bordered, selectable form controls (like plan cards); their text is padded inside each box the way a card pads its text.
